title: Ijwi ry'ubwenge
intro: Ijwi ry’ubukerebutsi ry’ubugwaneza ryarigeze gusangira impanuro zirenze igihe. Uwo mubare, uwahezagiwe n’ugutahura kwimbitse, waratanze ivyigwa vy’agaciro kanini biguma ari itara ku bantu bose bipfuza ubuyobozi. Woba ushobora gusobanura akaranga kari inyuma y’ayo majambo aramba?
clues: Narahawe umuhezagiro mwinshi cane uva kuri Allah, ingabirano yamurikiye umutima n’ubwenge bwanje.
Narahindukiriye umwana wanje nkunda cane, nipfuza gusangira ubutunzi bw’agaciro kuruta ubundi bwose nari mfise.
Naragabishije ko akarenganyo gakomeye kuruta ayandi ari ugushinga abafatanyabikorwa n’Imana imwe y’ukuri.
Naributse ko n’uburemere bw’akabuto ka sinapi, bwihishije mu rutare canke hirya y’ijuru, buzobazwa na Allah.
Narategetse kuba abavyeyi bafise inshingano, naho nyene ukugamburuka ari mu bijanye n’ubugororotsi gusa.
Narigishije inyifato yoroshe: genda wicishije bugufi kw’isi kandi ugereranije ijwi ryawe; kuko ijwi rikomeye kuruta ayandi yose ni uguboroga kw’indogoba.

trial.label: Ikigeragezo / Ivyabaye
options: Kubaka ubwato kugira ngo barokoke umwuzure mwinshi .
Gukora urugendo gushika ku mpera y'isi .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Impanuro ziwe zari zidapfa mu vyanditswe vy'Imana .
Yabaye umutware w’inkomezi aganza ubwami buhambaye .
Yaronse ihishurirwa ridasanzwe rivuye ku mumarayika .
outcome.answer: Impanuro ziwe zari zidapfa mu vyanditswe vy'Imana .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
